candidateBaseline.postFreezeRule: The branch, HEAD, and migration-count binding expires only after an independent D2 review and Freeze of this authorization; it is not a runtime implementation baseline or permission to implement.

functionDiagnosis.name: restaurant_current_access_context_v1()
functionDiagnosis.cause: The SQL function re-plans its RLS-expanded inner statement on each invocation instead of obtaining session plan-cache reuse.

runnerCorrection.sessionIsolation: Each track uses its own persistent database session; sessions are never shared across tracks.
runnerCorrection.coldDefinition: The cold run is only the first formal invocation in that new track session; it is not an OS-cache-cold, device-cache-cold, or PostgreSQL-shared-buffer-cleared claim.
runnerCorrection.connectionRule: No measured run may create a new connection or backend; cold, both warm-ups, and all seven measured runs remain in the same track session.
runnerCorrection.failureRule: An outer-track failure remains a formal failure even when inner-track evidence passes.

postgresServerPlanningTime.source: top-level EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) statement summary
postgresServerPlanningTime.separationRule: Never add to or relabel as Execution Time or clientWallTimeMs.

postgresServerExecutionTime.source: top-level EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) statement summary
postgresServerExecutionTime.outerFunctionScanRule: SQL-function initialization and inner planning inside an outer Function Scan remain outer PostgreSQL server Execution Time when PostgreSQL includes them there; they are never reclassified as client overhead.
postgresServerExecutionTime.separationRule: Never add to or relabel as Planning Time or clientWallTimeMs.

executionBuffers.source: the top-level Plan object of each EXPLAIN JSON run; these inclusive whole-plan values are execution-buffer totals for that run
executionBuffers.rawRunRule: Store every listed field separately for the cold run and each of the seven measured runs; warm-up values are diagnostic only and excluded from formal summaries.

summaryRules.maxSharedHitBlocks: maximum execution Shared Hit Blocks across the cold run and seven measured runs
summaryRules.maxWarmReadBlocks: maximum execution Shared Read Blocks across the seven measured runs
summaryRules.localAndTempLimits: maximum of the corresponding execution field across the cold run and seven measured runs

planningBuffers.source: the top-level Planning object of each EXPLAIN JSON run when PostgreSQL emits planning buffer fields
planningBuffers.separationRule: Store planning buffers with a planning-prefixed identity and never add them to or present them as execution-buffer threshold values.

clientWallTime.source: client monotonic clock around the complete request round trip
clientWallTime.separationRule: Keep separate from PostgreSQL Planning Time, Execution Time, and all planning or execution buffer fields.

outerWarmExecutionSummaries.sourceField: PostgreSQL top-level EXPLAIN JSON Execution Time
outerWarmExecutionSummaries.warmMedianMs: median of the seven outer server Execution Time values
outerWarmExecutionSummaries.warmMaximumMs: maximum of the seven outer server Execution Time values
outerWarmExecutionSummaries.outerFailureRule: Inner success never replaces, masks, or overrides an outer failure.

measurementContract.planningSummary: For each track, maximum Planning Time is computed across its cold run and seven measured runs; warm-ups and clientWallTimeMs are excluded.
measurementContract.metricSeparation: PostgreSQL server planning time, PostgreSQL server execution time, planning buffers, execution buffers, and clientWallTimeMs are distinct evidence classes and may never be added together or ambiguously relabeled.

runtimeRemediationAuthorization.purpose: Permit PostgreSQL session plan caching to absorb repeated RLS-expanded inner planning cost.

preservedFunctionInvariants.returnOrderRule: Every return column name, exact PostgreSQL type identity, typmod, array/enum/domain identity, and ordinal remains byte-for-byte semantically equivalent.

requiredBeforeAndAfter: pg_type schema-qualified identities for every return type
catalogEquivalenceEvidence.expectedFunctionResult: TABLE(restaurant_id text, role_key text, permission_key text, permission_scope text, branch_id text)
catalogEquivalenceEvidence.comparisonRule: Capture before and after values in the same PostgreSQL 17.6 suite and require exact equality plus exact schema-qualified return type identity; any mismatch fails closed.

guardSelfIntegrity.digestTarget: actual bytes of the executing guard file
guardSelfIntegrity.verificationOrder: verify before authority parsing or any semantic PASS check
guardSelfIntegrity.trustAnchorRule: The Corrected Candidate Report publishes the final guard digest and exact invocation; the next independent D2 reviewer supplies that external digest.
guardSelfIntegrity.circularHashProhibition: Do not hard-code the guard's final complete SHA-256 inside the guard or authority.
